title: kbmon's Needs-you disk line shows a share just under 10% as 10%, where the host alert shows it as 9.99%
goal: mon_needs.disk_entries rounds a free share just under 10% down to two decimals, as mon_host.alerts does, so the line never says 10% for a share under 10%

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import mon_needs as m
rows = m.disk_entries({"disk": {"free_pct": 10.0, "free_bytes": 99996, "total_bytes": 1000000}})
text = rows[0]["text"] if rows else ""
print(text)
sys.exit(0 if text == "disk 9.99% free" else 1)
